description: This file contains database query functions related to compliance history for boards and blocks in the focalboard project, including fetching historical data with pagination and filtering options.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer with methods for fetching compliance history data.

methods.name: getBoardsForCompliance
methods.description: Fetches a list of boards for compliance purposes with pagination and optional team filtering.

methods.name: getBoardsComplianceHistory
methods.description: Retrieves historical data of boards, including last and first update timestamps, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getBlocksComplianceHistory
methods.description: Retrieves historical data of blocks, including last and first update timestamps, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: boardsHistoryFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a slice of BoardHistory models.

methods.name: blocksHistoryFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a slice of BlockHistory models.
